description: Create a unified logging utility at src/lib/logger.ts with log(), warn(), error(), debug() methods that auto-include file/line context, strip dev-only logs in production, and create Sentry breadcrumbs for non-dev logs
steps: Create src/lib/logger.ts with the full logging implementation
Implement getCallerContext() to extract filename and line number from Error stack (skip internal frames)
Implement sendToSentry() to add breadcrumbs via Sentry.addBreadcrumb (respect scrubEvent rules)
Export log object with log(), warn(), error(), debug() methods
Add __DEV__ guards to log() and debug() to strip them in production builds
Ensure error() and warn() always log (never silent)
acceptance_criteria: Logger utility can be imported from '../lib/logger' in any file
log() calls show timestamp and file:line context in console output
log.debug() is stripped in production (no runtime overhead)
Sentry breadcrumbs are created for warn/error logs
Existing tests still pass after creating the file
verification: Add test call in a component, verify console output includes timestamp and context
Check Sentry dashboard for breadcrumbs after warn/error calls
